title: Galaxy500Universe
tagline: Galaxy500Universe is an AI and crypto-base Galactic Economy for the New AI Age.
description: This project aims to create a new Galactic economy given the projected economic impacts of AI on the modern age. A social media website will be used as the "new world" where members become citizens by registering themselves and given an account they can post life events and situations. Citizens can create businesses and these businesses with trade on an exchange. Citizens can bet on how well these businesses will perform. Life is free in this universe. Citizens once 18 years old and over can apply for free funds to start businesses and can do so every 5 years. Businesses can also apply for funds annual if necessary. A death or "end-of-time" report is created when the human no longer exists. It will report import stats and total funding, total value at EOT. This project mirrors life in some ways.
how_its_made: This project will mainly be vibe-coded. The sponsor systems to be used: ARC, Ledger, Li.Fi and possibly ENS. Arc's EVM-compatible blockchain will be used instead of Ethereum for its low fees and quick finality. For long term storage of token resources the Ledger Wallet will be used. For more short term wallet activities Li.Fi will be used. ENS will be used for onchain names. The AI to be used is undetermined at this point.
auto_summary: A Next.js social simulation app where users manage profiles, posts, startups, banking, trading, and wallet-related actions with Supabase-backed data.
